notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.39

• Liquid Glass — the Start menu and quick panel now frost the wallpaper behind them, with a soft glass sheen.
• Crash detection — turn it on in Settings › Medical ID. After a hard fall or crash, DuckOS asks if you're OK and opens Emergency if you don't answer. It never calls by itself.
• Dynamic Island — a little pill around the camera shows live things like charging and timers, over any app. Tap it for more. Turn it off in Settings › Display.
